text.p: These were the headlines on Kuku Raadio at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Local residents say that the granting of permits to build housing on the shore of Holy Lake is illegal and they will still fight the decision.
- Eduard Hammalainen, a Belarussian citizen with Finnish ancestors who competed for Finland during the recent World Games in Athens, has applied for Finnish citizenship.
- The Reform Party said that the Prime Minister, Mart Siimann, is breaking his promises to the party.
